rows.description: The rows the connector wrote; absent when the run failed before its result was verified.

state_check.description: The state check the spec declares for this run, if any.

ConnectorTestStateCheck.description: A state check a `[[run]]` in `connector-test.toml` declares: `unchanged` (the run must return the state it was given) or `advanced` (the run must return another state).

description:
JSON output for `rocky connector test <name>`.

The command runs the connector once per `[[run]]` in its `connector-test.toml`, feeding each run the state the run before it returned. It loads nothing and saves no state.

passed.description: `true` when every run passed every check.

runs.description: One entry per run that started, in order. A failed run stops the test, so later runs are not listed.

spec.description: The test spec that was read.

warnings.description: Problems that do not fail the test, such as a stale helper copy.

title: ConnectorTestOutput
